dedupe_keys.name: anas road graph of the italian national road network grafo stradale anas december 2015

description: The Grafo stradale ANAS is the complete road graph of the network managed by ANAS, the Italian national roads company, as it stood in December 2015. It holds motorways, motorway links, state roads, new ANAS roads and service roads, with junction arcs grouped into intersection areas and separate features for carriageways running in the decreasing kilometre direction. Each arc has the ANAS road code, road name, road type and the ANAS regional compartment. It was produced by the ANAS general directorate and is published on the open data portal of the Italian Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport, which also hosts ANAS average daily traffic data for the same network. Coverage is national, for the ANAS network only (not regional, provincial or municipal roads or tolled concession motorways outside ANAS). The data are free to download as an ESRI shapefile with a CSV-W metadata file describing the fields, under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the graph has not been refreshed since 2015, so later transfers of roads between ANAS and the regions are missing, and it carries no lanes, speeds or capacities; ANAS points to its web page on network consistency for road classification. The graph supports network flow, capacity planning and hazard exposure studies of the Italian trunk road network, for example landslide or flood exposure of state roads, and complements OpenStreetMap-based networks catalogued here.
name: ANAS road graph of the Italian national road network (Grafo stradale ANAS, December 2015)
provider: ANAS S.p.A. (Azienda Nazionale Autonoma delle Strade), published on the open data portal of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport

sources.note: title; notes (complete ANAS graph, consistency updated to December 2015; link to ANAS network consistency page); licence CC-BY-4.0; author Direzione Generale ANAS; organisation ANAS; resources SHP GrafoANAS_dic2015.zip and JSON metadata; temporal 2015-11-01 to 2015-12-31

CSV-W field list: COD_STRA (road code types A, RA, SS, NSA, SSV; junction arcs; '<' for decreasing carriageways), COM_SIGLA, SECONDONOM, COD_COM, AMM (road type codes incl. 99 junctions), COD_INT (intersection area)

spatial_resolution: road arcs and junction arcs of the ANAS network
